principles: Idea → Script → Record → Pick → Edit → Ready → Share. Every extra step must justify itself (DESIGN_DIRECTION).
Context: show the right tool at the right moment; writing looks like writing, recording like recording.
Color roles: violet #B4A7FF / #9D8CFF = AI (✦, My Cue Voice, Smart); solid yellow #FFD60A = the one primary action or ✓; yellow mono text = HUD signals (counters, time, status).
Controls follow Cue Controls: selected text chip white/black; selected tile 2px yellow ring + 12% tint; active segment #636366; toggle #34C759; slider 4px yellow track + 24px white thumb.
Surfaces Night Session: background #0A0B12 with slow aurora, cards #161826, glass rgba(14,16,28,0.6–0.88) + 0.5px violet rim rgba(180,167,255,0.22).
Bottom 34–44pt (home indicator / multitask) never holds a touch target. Editor panels have fixed height and never scroll vertically; overflow becomes chips or tabs.
Appearance: Automatic follows iOS. Video screens and their sheets always dark; tabs, script page and their sheets follow Appearance. Tokens in cue-colors.json.

nodes.name: Tab bar
nodes.desc: Scripts · Takes · ● Record (center) · Profile · Settings. Glass night, active tab yellow label.

nodes.name: Scripts home
nodes.desc: Hero “Let’s Cue!” (violet aurora + yellow scan line): idea field, mic, ✦ arrow, “For TikTok ⌄”, “✦ My Cue Voice”. HUD counter “06 SCRIPTS / 14 TAKES”. Recent list with search and “All ⌄”. Empty state + “Record without a script”.
states: row status = pipeline stage of its takes (● 3 TAKES · READY)

nodes.name: New script sheet
nodes.desc: Only Write my own / Import (the AI prompt lives in S1, not repeated here).

nodes.name: Import
nodes.desc: Scan, Photo (text recognition), File, Paste.

nodes.name: Need an idea?
nodes.desc: Ideas from the creator’s topics (My Cue Voice).

nodes.name: Format
nodes.desc: How Cue structures the script (hook, list, story…).

nodes.name: Script page
nodes.desc: Single page, Draft | Shaped. AI writes into the page (violet). Free writing first; “Shape for TikTok” adapts to cues and platform rules on demand.

nodes.name: Script editor (legacy)
nodes.desc: Versions, blocks, cues (yellow = creator marks), “✦ Improve with Cue” (violet).

nodes.name: Create for
nodes.desc: Platform presets (aspect, length, safe zones).

nodes.name: Hooks
nodes.desc: Hook variations (✦ violet, Pro).

nodes.name: My Cue Voice flow
nodes.desc: 4 questions 01/04 → role · topics (12 + more, sub-niches) · audience · tone. Then the script is the preview: “My voice | Without”, Sounds like me / Adjust (scope: this script | profile).

nodes.name: Record tab
nodes.desc: Pick a script to record — or go freestyle.

nodes.name: Selfie recorder
nodes.desc: Bar 4a (glass night): [Voice | Steady] + ⤒ + play + Aa · SPEED slider (Steady) or hint (Voice) · HUD line ● MIC · SETUP › · last take · camera settings · ● record · flip · •••.
states: recording (compact bar: mode chip, ⤒, pause, Stop, 00:23 yellow, TAKE 4 · TIKTOK SETUP)

nodes.name: Studio recorder
nodes.desc: Same bar as Selfie; Remote replaces flip; REC pill on top; full-screen text.

nodes.name: Recorder sheets
nodes.desc: Display (Aa), Camera & recording, Audio input, This take (recommended vs your setup).

nodes.name: Stop → take saved
nodes.desc: Stop early → “Keep going” warning. Stop → take added to the script → review.

nodes.name: Take review
nodes.desc: Paused by default (play button). Top glass: back · TAKE 3 · 1:02 · ★ ring · delete. Compare chip “2 / 3” + swipe. Strip scrub + mute. Panel: title, HUD line (✓ FITS), PICK·EDIT·READY·SHARED bar, From script ›, ✦ suggested best (violet). Actions: Continue/Edit · Retake · Save (round glass) + Share to <platform> (yellow). 4 OF 5 FREE EXPORTS · GO PRO (no watermark, ever).

nodes.name: Takes tab
nodes.desc: Pipeline TO PICK › IN EDIT › READY › SHARED (counts, tap = filter) + NEXT line. Grid 9:16 (default) or list. Platform “All ⌄”. Swipe Share/Delete, hold = peek.

nodes.name: Share / Save
nodes.desc: Share to platform or Save to Photos. Clears draft, sets exported → SHARED. Free: decrements exportsLeft; at 0 → paywall.

nodes.name: Editor
nodes.desc: Top: back (keeps draft, no question) · IN EDIT · AUTOSAVED · Done (yellow). Preview, transport (00:12 / 00:42 mono). Timeline: Cover tile, main track, lanes Aa (white) · captions (violet) · music (green) · voice-over (amber) · overlay (light blue), chips “Aa +”. Toolbar (CapCut order): Edit, Audio, Text, Captions, Filters, Adjust, Crop, Background, Overlay, ✦ Smart. Clip selected: white frame + yellow handles, Delete fixed red.

nodes.name: Editor panels
nodes.desc: Fixed height (header 44 · content ≈176) above system zone. One parameter at a time: chip pager when content overflows. Adjust = chips + ruler + ◐ hold; Text = Style·Font·Color·Motion; Cover = Frame·Text·Elements·Look, Preview: Feed | Profile grid (3×3 series grid, this cover ringed yellow) (layouts, ✦ titles, highlight word, arrow/circle/EP/NEW/@handle, Text behind me, My cover style); Smart = captions, pauses, Studio Voice, auto adjust; Captions = horizontal line cards.

nodes.name: Is it ready to post?
nodes.desc: Asked every time the creator taps Done. Header “EDIT SAVED · 1:02” — no platform names; sharing is generic.
actions: → SHARED · pick the app in the share sheet
Saves to Photos · counts as export → SHARED

nodes.name: Editor sheets
nodes.desc: Add music (Files), Add photo or video.

nodes.name: Profile
nodes.desc: Who I am / how I create: identity, My Cue Voice card (What Cue uses, editable rows, voice examples), Creator preferences, plan card (FREE PLAN or ● PRO ACTIVE, night aurora).

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.desc: How the app behaves: Your setup card (Camera, Quality, Mic, Text → pages), tiles Recording · Prompter · Remote, General (Language & Region, Appearance, Privacy & AI data), Purchases & About, Reset Creator Setup.

nodes.name: Recording
nodes.desc: Camera, mic, quality, format defaults.

nodes.name: Teleprompter
nodes.desc: Sticky proportional preview (static) + section chips: Reading, Text, Line, Window/Safe zones (Selfie) or Background (Studio), While recording.

nodes.name: Remote
nodes.desc: Hero ring grey/yellow/green, QR pairing, Use this device as a remote.

nodes.name: Language & Region
nodes.desc: App, voice-following and script language.

nodes.name: Acknowledgements
nodes.desc: Fonts and licenses.

nodes.name: Cue Pro
nodes.desc: Night + violet/yellow aurora, ● CUE PRO mono, benefits card (AI rows violet), plans (2px yellow ring), glass footer CTA. Export context shows 05 / 05 FREE EXPORTS USED meter.

machines.name: Video pipeline (per video = takes of one script)
machines.rule: First match: >1 take and none ★ → PICK BEST · draft open → IN EDIT · not exported → READY · exported → SHARED. Never set by hand.

machines.name: Recorder
machines.rule: idle → countdown (•••) → recording (compact bar) → stop (warn if very short) → take saved → review

machines.name: Free / Pro
machines.rule: Free: 5 exports, 5 AI scripts / month; every feature visible. Pro = “I want more of this”, never a lock.
